name: Share File or Folder
description: Add a [sharing permission](https://support.google.com/drive/answer/7166529) to the sharing preferences of a file or folder and provide a sharing URL. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/reference/permissions/create)

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: useFileOrFolder
configurable_props.label: Use File or Folder
configurable_props.description: Whether to use a file or a folder for this action

configurable_props.name: fileId
configurable_props.label: File
configurable_props.description: The file to share. You must specify either a file or a folder.

configurable_props.name: folderId
configurable_props.label: Folder
configurable_props.description: The folder to share. You must specify either a file or a folder.

configurable_props.name: type
configurable_props.label: Type
configurable_props.description: The type of the grantee. Sharing with a domain is only valid for G Suite users.
